name: Stronghold
description: The former home of the Rathi evincars, transported into a volcano during the Rathi Overlay.

description_citations.text: "Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath confronts Greven, claiming him as his own.
timeline.quote: And you, Greven, are mine.

citation.text: Dominate (Nemesis, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax announces that things are going to change.
timeline.quote: Things are going to change around here.

citation.text: Ascendant Evincar (Nemesis, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax orders the enemy killed and fed to new recruits.
timeline.quote: Kill them all and feed them to the new recruits.

citation.text: Death Pit Offering (Nemesis, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Needle presents a black soul-drinking sword to Sadage as a gift for the Scion of Darkness.
timeline.quote: I bring you a gift for the Scion of Darkness.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Sadage insists the sword's legend be credited to Belzenlok rather than another planeswalker.
timeline.quote: It was Belzenlok! Belzenlok forged it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Sadage kills Needle with a spell as her reward.
timeline.quote: Slowly, Needle's skin peeled from her chest as the violet spell light gently pierced her heart.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Sadage goes to present the black blade to Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: Sadage opened the doors to the worship hall, ready to present the black blade to his chosen master

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana vows to destroy Belzenlok's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: I will pry open his Stronghold, slaughter his grimnants, and destroy his legacy.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna notes the Blackblade is locked in the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: It's also locked up in the Stronghold,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira asks Teferi for a time mage to help them enter the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We're going to kill Belzenlok and we need a time mage to help us get into the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: At dawn the party sees the Stronghold in the volcano's caldera, and Gideon, Chandra, Karn and Teferi set out on foot.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok has done some rebuilding,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi casts a time-slowing spell around Gideon and Chandra, who walk through the Stronghold's frozen guards.
timeline.quote: Then he realized Teferi and Karn had seemed to freeze in place

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Chandra climb the gate and cross traps past still guards.
timeline.quote: Careful to stay close together, they climbed the gate, the broad crosspieces making a good ladder.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Chandra enter the first hall, then Chandra chains Gideon as her prisoner when the time spell ends.
timeline.quote: Chandra fastened the chains around Gideon's wrists.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The time spell ends and the Stronghold fills with noise as Cabal cultists run to the defenses.
timeline.quote: Slowly, the silence around them filled like water poured into a bowl.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Chandra, delayed and without the expected diversion, are swept by a crowd into the fighting pit arena.
timeline.quote: Gideon tried to use his chains to brace her, but hands pushed him from behind and they stumbled into the arena with the crowd.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok appears in the arena to the cultists' chanting, and Whisper orders captives into the pit.
timeline.quote: Into the pit, for the glory of Belzenlok!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Chandra to push him into the pit to buy time, and she does.
timeline.quote: Chandra shoved him, and Gideon pretended to stagger, then tumbled backward into the pit.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon falls into the pit, kills a maddened attacker, and takes a sword while the prisoners fight under dementia magic.
timeline.quote: That was when he realized everyone attacking him was wild-eyed with dementia magic.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon joins a back-to-back group led by the warrior Radha.
timeline.quote: She thrust her sword through the chest of a black-robed cultist and said, "I'm Radha."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok leaves the arena to defend the Stronghold, and Chandra searches for a way to free Gideon.
timeline.quote: Then Belzenlok stood. His voice roared, "Defend the Stronghold!"

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Whisper begins to kill the pit prisoners with black mist, and Chandra attacks her and her guards with fire.
timeline.quote: Whisper was going to kill the rest of the prisoners in the pit.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra burns the chain lock on the stair mechanism and lowers the stairs so Gideon and the other prisoners can climb out.
timeline.quote: Chandra ran back to the stair mechanism, burned through the chain lock, and threw the lever.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Radha throws a knife into Whisper's eye, killing her after Gideon's shield deflects her spell.
timeline.quote: Then suddenly a blade blossomed in Whisper's right eye.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Radha agrees to help Gideon and Chandra after hearing the Weatherlight has been restored.
timeline.quote: "Then I'll come with you." Radha turned to the others.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Karn rejoin the ship as the Weatherlight attacks, and Teferi dissolves the first gate while Jhoira's owl blows up the next with a mana-burner.
timeline.quote: Teferi held out his hand and the gate across the causeway turned red with corrosion, then dissolved in a puff of rust.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urgoros rises from the volcano on a dragon-like mount to attack the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: I think that's Urgoros!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra blasts open the treasury doors with fire.
timeline.quote: Her fire washed over it, white-hot, and burned away chains, the sigils powering the guard spells, and the door itself.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira realizes Urgoros is only a distraction, and the spirits build a tower of bodies to lower Liliana to the ground.
timeline.quote: They kept coming, the tower of spirit bodies rising higher and higher.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Chandra and Radha find the Blackblade in the fourth treasury vault and fight through the Stronghold's hall as the undead overwhelm the Cabal.
timeline.quote: They had found the weapon inside the fourth treasury vault, mounted on a stone plinth like a trophy.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon draws the Blackblade and confronts Belzenlok outside the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Gideon took a deep breath and drew the Blackblade.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok recognizes Gideon as a planeswalker of the Gatewatch and says he knows what is planned for them.
timeline.quote: You. The Gatewatch. I know what's planned for you.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana taunts Belzenlok about her brother and the pact signers she has killed to draw him away from Gideon.
timeline.quote: You should have left my brother alone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok knocks Gideon down, but the Blackblade pierces his thigh and Liliana grabs the hilt.
timeline.quote: Liliana leapt forward, under Belzenlok's arm, and seized the Blackblade's hilt.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana drains Belzenlok's life with the Blackblade and kills him; his body collapses into lumps of flesh.
timeline.quote: What was left of Belzenlok collapsed into lumps of white flesh.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds the lines of her pact are still on her skin after Belzenlok's death.
timeline.quote: but the lines of her pact were still written on her skin.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon gives Teferi the Gatewatch oath, while Karn and Jaya agree to fight Bolas without taking the oath.
timeline.quote: Gideon was giving Teferi the Gatewatch oath while Chandra stood by.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers leave Dominaria, but Liliana cannot planeswalk and Nicol Bolas appears to claim her.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas materialized out of the darkness, his huge scaled dragon form looming over her

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas reveals that Liliana's pact defaults to its broker, himself, when her demons die, and he threatens that disobedience will kill her.
timeline.quote: You seem unaware that with your demons dead, your contract defaults to its broker.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas planeswalks away and Liliana follows, resolved to find an escape while staying alive.
timeline.quote: Sick at heart, bound like a prisoner to a new incarnation of a fate she had schemed so long to cheat, Liliana followed in his wake.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon returns to the empty Stronghold court, finds Liliana's aether trail leading away from the others, and leaves Dominaria.
timeline.quote: She had left Dominaria, but she hadn't followed him and the others.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gerrard lands in the Stronghold throne room where a crazed Crovax stands over Squee.
timeline.quote: with a crazed Crovax standing over the broken form of Squee

citation.text: "Apocalypse", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Coalition forces fight their way to the Stronghold and battle Crovax's Phyrexian soldiers.
timeline.quote: fight their way to the Stronghold, where they battle Crovax's Phyrexian soldiers

citation.text: "Apocalypse", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, Lin Sivvi and Grizzlegom search for a backdoor into the Stronghold and meet dwarves planning to blast a tunnel.
timeline.quote: try to find a backdoor into the Stronghold

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard lands in the Stronghold throne room, reunites with Squee, and they defeat Phyrexian troops; Ertai summons Crovax back.
timeline.quote: Ertai realizes he can't defeat Gerrard and summons Crovax back to the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard kills Crovax, Squee fries Ertai, and the Dominarian forces escape on the Weatherlight as lava engulfs the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Gerrard kills Crovax with an axe

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax brutally kills a shapeshifter in Selenia's form.
timeline.quote: Crovax, in a fit of rage, brutally killed a shapeshifter

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn refuses to fight when taken to witness Tahngarth's mutation.
timeline.quote: refused to fight, believing that remorse would outlast rage.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The rescue party frees Karn and Tahngarth, but the 'Sisay' they find is a shapeshifter.
timeline.quote: They successfully freed Karn and Tahngarth

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn encounters the Sliver Queen and claims the Legacy pieces.
timeline.quote: Karn encountered the Sliver Queen in her lair

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna drags the Predator into a collision with the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Hanna, acting quickly, managed to drag the Predator into a collision with the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Belbe restores order at the Stronghold and shortlists Crovax, Greven il-Vec and Ertai as evincar, preferring Ertai.
timeline.quote: Ertai made the best impression on her

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Belbe grows disillusioned with Phyrexia, disables the Eye of Yawgmoth, and falls in love with Ertai.
timeline.quote: She disabled the Eye of Yawgmoth implanted in her

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Belbe begins a plan to cut flowstone production to prevent the Rathi Overlay.
timeline.quote: she also set in motion a plan to decrease flowstone production at the Stronghold

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax attacks Belbe, who defends herself.
timeline.quote: Crovax attacked her, but Belbe was able to defend herself

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Captured Eladamri attacks Belbe in rage on seeing his daughter's corpse reanimated; Belbe has him imprisoned and interrogated.
timeline.quote: Eladamri lashed out at her in rage

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax organizes a coup and Belbe is forced to crown him evincar after a showdown with Ertai and the returning Volrath.
timeline.quote: Crovax organized a coup d'état to force her to declare him evincar

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri's wife dies in a fire that destroyed their home, likely perpetrated by Stronghold agents.
timeline.quote: His wife died in a fire that destroyed their home.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Lord of Leaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri leads a frontal assault on the Stronghold but cannot breach the Portcullis and calls a retreat.
timeline.quote: Eladamri realized that the day was lost and was forced to call a retreat.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Lord of Leaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri discovers Belbe looks identical to Avila, her corpse twisted into a Phyrexian pawn, and is captured.
timeline.quote: Belbe looked identical to Avila.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri is tortured by Greven, escapes, and frees Takara.
timeline.quote: He freed the emaciated girl, and together they tried to flee the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Belbe opens a portal; Eladamri poisons her with the same poison that killed Avila and flees to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: It quickly overpowered even Belbe’s robust physiology, killing her in a matter of seconds.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The allies find Gerrard, Squee and Urza's head in the throne room as Yawgmoth emerges as a Black Cloud of Death and they flee on Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth began emerging through the planar portal in the throne room in the form of a Black Cloud of Death

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Selenia, which triggers a curse that turns him into a vampire.
timeline.quote: Crovax killed her, but this triggered a curse on him and turned him into a vampire .

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Dream Halls Gerrard realizes Volrath is his adoptive brother Vuel.
timeline.quote: Gerrard suddenly had flashbacks to his youth and the actions of Vuel, and realized the truth: Volrath was Vuel!

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard stabs his brother, but later learns he killed only a shapeshifter scapegoat.
timeline.quote: Volrath had used a scapegoat and that he had just killed another shapeshifter

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax, now evincar, takes Gerrard to Phyrexia where Gerrard pledges loyalty to Yawgmoth in hope of Hanna's return.
timeline.quote: where he pledged his loyalty to Yawgmoth, who promised he could bring Hanna back from the dead.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard kills Crovax in the Stronghold's throne room.
timeline.quote: Gerrard confronted and killed Crovax

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven abandons his people and joins the Stronghold's oppressors, becoming il-Vec and rising to command Predator.
timeline.quote: Greven turned his back on his people and joined their oppressors

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath orders Greven to intercept Weatherlight and bring back the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard.
timeline.quote: the evincar Volrath entrusted Greven with a crucial mission

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven begins mutating the captured Tahngarth into a Phyrexian as a replacement for Vhati.
timeline.quote: Greven, therefore, began mutating the minotaur

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight smashes Predator into the Stronghold, then escapes through the Erratic Portal and Predator crashes into the rock face.
timeline.quote: Unable to stop in time, Predator smashed into the rock face, sustaining heavy damage.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath has vanished and the Stronghold falls into chaos; Greven takes charge and meets candidate Crovax and emissary Belbe.
timeline.quote: the evincar had disappeared, throwing the rest of the Stronghold into chaos.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven and Crovax fight and Crovax uses the mimetic spine to lay Greven low.
timeline.quote: Crovax had worked out how to control Greven

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven turns down Belbe's offer to be considered for evincar, preferring to be the sword rather than the hand.
timeline.quote: Greven turned down the offer, saying he had seen what having such power turned its bearer into.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai proposes taking 5,000 hostages from the human communities to prevent rebellion, and Greven rounds them up.
timeline.quote: Ertai came up with the plan to take 5,000 hostages from the three human communities

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax returns to the Stronghold and slaughters all the hostages.
timeline.quote: Crovax had survived and had teleported back to the Stronghold, where he had discovered the hostages and slaughtered every last one of them.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven tortures the captured Eladamri but cannot break him.
timeline.quote: However, Greven was unable to break him.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Furah reveals himself to Greven as the returned Volrath.
timeline.quote: Greven was stunned when Furah revealed he was Volrath, who had returned to reclaim his title.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven interrupts Crovax's coronation, Volrath resumes his true form, and Crovax defeats him in a duel after Ertai interferes.
timeline.quote: Ertai interfered by magically off-balancing Volrath, allowing Crovax to triumph.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Stronghold, Mirri's sense of smell exposes a shapeshifting minion of Volrath disguised as Sisay.
timeline.quote: Her sense of smell saved the crew from one of Volrath 's shapeshifting minions

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirri dives in front of Crovax to deflect Selenia's strike and is gravely wounded; Crovax slays Selenia and Tahngarth carries both back to the ship.
timeline.quote: Mirri dove in front of him to deflect one of Selenia's strikes.

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax's assault on Eladamri's Skyshroud elves ends in a rout; he consolidates power by impaling dissenting tribal leaders on flowstone spikes.
timeline.quote: the attack ends in a rout

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Flowstone machinery resumes full operation and the Rathi overlay onto Dominaria begins.
timeline.quote: As the Rathi overlay onto Dominaria begins

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Stone dwarves channel a magma lake that buries the Stronghold's lower levels and pours into Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: The lower levels of the Stronghold were buried in molten rock

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai reveals himself and teleports Gerrard and Squee into the Stronghold, where Crovax kills Squee to prove Yawgmoth can bring back the dead.
timeline.quote: To prove it he kills Squee, who is then granted the ability to come back from the dead.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rathi rebels including Eladamri and Lin Sivvi attempt to sabotage the docked Predator but are foiled.
timeline.quote: Unfortunately, they were foiled

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri decides the elves will attack the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Eladamri decides that the time has come for the elves to attack the Stronghold

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Hanna's Tale" ( Miranda Horner )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirri kills a guard as the crew docks at the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Mirri slew a guard who had noticed them before he had time to scream.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard sees the map of Volrath's invasion plans for Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Gerrard realizes that it represents Volrath's Invasion Plans

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn surrenders to the Predator after accidentally killing a mogg.
timeline.quote: after surrendering to the Predator once he accidentally killed a mogg during the ambush

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Karn's Tale" ( J. Robert King )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn refuses to kill his torturers in the Stronghold.
